fields.acceptance: A new cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/daemon-plans-proposals.txtar (Rex faked, RHIZA_TEST_DETACH_LOG): a change set proposed with a leaf and no run makes rhiza daemon --once start one plan-review run naming it with --autonomous and the daemon's permission mode; a second poll while that start is pending starts nothing more; a proposed change set with no leaves, one a finished plan run's gated entry names, one a finished plan-milestone run on another change set (the record change set) left proposed and whose gated entry names it, one a finished plan-review run's gated entry names (started --workflow plan-review without --new, gate left it proposed under rhiza.autonomy.accept owner), one whose plan-review run ended failed and one whose plan run ended failed start nothing on this or a following poll; one whose only run was abandoned gets a start; with --max-runs 1 and a ready accepted change set the proposal's start and the ship pick share the slot without exceeding it; under rhiza daemon pause nothing starts. internal/api/proposals_test.go covers uncoveredProposals over journals of workflow plan, plan-milestone and plan-review, gated, failed, abandoned and live, including a plan-milestone run whose own change set differs from the gated change set it names. go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... and go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/daemon-' pass. Touches internal/api/daemon.go, internal/api/daemon_fold.go, internal/api/daemon_projects.go, internal/api/proposals.go, internal/api/proposals_test.go, cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/daemon-plans-proposals.txtar
fields.statement: Each daemon poll starts, as a detached rhiza run start --foreground <change> --workflow plan-review --autonomous --permission-mode <the daemon's mode>, a plan-review run for every proposed change set with leaves that no run covers. Covered is defined by a run's change set, workflow and journal, never by run.State.IsPlanRun or isPlanWorkflow (which know only plan and plan-milestone, and stay unchanged): a change set is covered while any run on it is live or its start is pending and not yet journaled, when any finished run whose workflow is plan, plan-milestone or plan-review (or that run.State.IsPlanRun reports), whatever its own change set (a plan-milestone run on the record change set gates every change set serving the intents it creates), has a latest gated entry naming it, or when any run on it, plan-review included, ended failed and was not abandoned. These starts count against max-runs after the resumes and before the ship picks, and stop under pause, low disk, the load and memory holds and a usage hold like any other start; one shared predicate (uncoveredProposals in internal/api) decides covered, for the daemon and the inbox
